name: RevitWorkspaceDevOps
description: Manages inverted multi-version preprocessor conditioning, on-demand documentation compilation, codebase bundle aggregation, and Google Drive synchronization.

commands.description: Manually triggers a workspace sweep to audit .csproj version numbers against the active CURRENT_LATEST_VERSION constant.

Rebuilds all source bundle markdown files via aggregate.py, then pushes all configured sync_targets to Google Drive via sync_all.py. Requires Google API credentials in the Support/auth directory. Install dependencies first: pip install -r .agents/plugins/RevitWorkspaceDevOps/requirements.txt
Pulls configured Google Docs down as local markdown files using pull_config.json. If target names (e.g. adrs, prds) are specified, only pulls those target folders, leaving others untouched.

lifecycle_hooks.description: Sweeps the solution file structure upon chat boot to ensure the environment constant aligns with the highest compiled Revit version.

dependencies.note: Google Drive sync scripts require Python packages. Run: pip install -r .agents/plugins/RevitWorkspaceDevOps/requirements.txt
